title: Fresher Behavioral & HR Questions
intro: Fresher behavioral and HR rounds test communication, not experience. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with 'tell me about yourself' (the opener every interview starts with), then the motivation questions (why Java backend, why this company). Strengths and weaknesses and career goals follow, then the technical-behavioral bridge — project discussion. Teamwork and conflict are the interpersonal tier, and salary/offer questions close the round.
